capabilities: Push and pull Markdown notes to a Feishu Wiki space
Convert notes into editable Feishu documents
Preview sync plans and report conflicts
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.13.7+; not published to the community plugin market, installed from a release ZIP or built from source. Free, no telemetry. App Secret, tokens and sync mappings are stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json. Does not support Notion, Feishu Bitable or international Lark.
problem: Notes written in Obsidian cannot be read or edited by teammates in a Feishu Wiki without copying them over by hand.

relations.evidence: 飞书文档和图片接口实现参考了 Lark CLI 的请求格式与素材处理流程

requires.name: Feishu self-built app App ID and App Secret
Feishu account with access to the target wiki space

summary: Two-way sync between Obsidian Markdown notes and a Feishu Wiki space, stored there as editable Feishu documents or raw .md files.
